subject: Graduate Civil Engineer application (SEEK 95872340)
email_body:
Dear PCP Solutions team,

I am applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer role in Toowoomba that you advertised on SEEK (95872340), which invites resumes and cover letters to this address.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, designing and documenting road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, carrying out inspections and quality checks, reviewing drawings, tracking materials and preparing progress reports.

Your advert's mix of ITPs, quality records, daily progress reporting and drawing review is the kind of site and documentation work I want to build on. I have not worked on water infrastructure yet. I live in Melton, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, am available for regional site work and am open to discussing relocation to Toowoomba.

Could we arrange a short call about the role?

I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.company_line: PCP Solutions is a Toowoomba civil earthworks and commercial plumbing business delivering large scale infrastructure works for Tier 1 contractors across South East Queensland.
letter.subject: Graduate Civil Engineer, Toowoomba (SEEK 95872340)
paragraphs: Please accept my application for the Graduate Civil Engineer role in Toowoomba. Your advert describes site inspections, Inspection and Test Plans, daily progress reporting and drawing review under experienced project managers and site engineers, and that is the work I want to grow in.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia. In that course I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards, and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, reviewed drawings, tracked procurement and materials, prepared site, material and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

I have not worked on water infrastructure yet, and I would learn your Integrated Management System and Tier 1 reporting from the team. I live in Melton, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, am available for regional site work and am open to discussing relocation to Toowoomba.
My resume is attached, and I would welcome the chance to talk about the role.

checklist: Search Gmail in:anywhere for PCP Solutions and pcpsolutions.com.au before sending (Gmail was not reachable on this tick)
